brief: Lead gen before vs after AI agents — pipeline doubled, CAC cut in half.

slots.title: Stop manual
slots.description: AI agents double qualified pipeline and cut customer acquisition cost in half.

slots.title: Qualify leads
slots.description: AI agents research and score prospects instantly instead of waiting for manual review.
slots.badText: Sales reps wasted hours researching unfit prospects every single week.
slots.goodText: AI agents score and route only qualified opportunities automatically.

slots.title: Reply in
slots.description: Stop losing deals to competitors who respond while your team is offline.
slots.badText: Prospects waited hours or days for a response and lost interest.
slots.goodText: AI answers every inbound lead instantly, day or night.

slots.title: Personalize every
slots.description: Generic templates kill trust. AI writes unique messages using real prospect data.
slots.badText: Mass emails felt robotic and landed straight in spam folders.
slots.goodText: AI crafts tailored outreach that sounds human and converts.

slots.title: Book more
slots.description: Eliminate back-and-forth scheduling so your calendar fills itself while you sleep.
slots.badText: Reps played email tag to find a time that worked.
slots.goodText: AI offers real-time slots and confirms meetings without human help.

slots.title: Double your
slots.description: AI agents work around the clock to keep your funnel overflowing with opportunities.
slots.badText: One rep could only manage a hundred leads per quarter.
slots.goodText: Digital workers scale outreach to thousands without hiring another rep.

slots.title: Cut CAC
slots.description: Automate top-of-funnel work so your budget stretches further on every acquisition.
slots.badText: High salaries and ad spend drove customer acquisition through the roof.
slots.goodText: AI handles prospecting at a fraction of the traditional cost.

slots.body: Join teams doubling qualified pipeline and cutting acquisition costs in half this quarter.
